```{python}
#| label: ego-extract
def csp_ego_graph(edges_df, nodes_df, k=18):
    """Extract CSP1-2 + top k co-occurring genera by edge weight."""
    # CSP1-2 might appear as "CSP1-2" or similar - find its exact name
    csp_names = [n for n in pd.unique(edges_df[["source","target"]].values.ravel())
                 if isinstance(n, str) and ("CSP1-2" in n or "Dadabacteria" in n)]
    if not csp_names:
        return None
    csp = csp_names[0]
    # Get edges incident to CSP
    inc = edges_df[(edges_df.source == csp) | (edges_df.target == csp)].copy()
    inc["partner"] = inc.apply(lambda r: r.target if r.source == csp else r.source, axis=1)
    # Take top by |weight|
    inc = inc.sort_values("weight", key=lambda s: s.abs(), ascending=False).head(k)
    # Build graph on CSP + partners
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_node(csp, is_csp=True)
    for _, r in inc.iterrows():
        G.add_node(r.partner, is_csp=False)
        G.add_edge(csp, r.partner, weight=r.weight, sign=r.sign)
    return G, csp

def plot_ego(G, csp, ax, title):
    pos = nx.spring_layout(G, k=0.8, iterations=60, seed=42)
    # Edges: width by |weight|, color by sign
    for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True):
        w = abs(d["weight"])
        c = "#b91c1c" if d["sign"] < 0 else "#1d4ed8"
        ax.plot([pos[u][0], pos[v][0]], [pos[u][1], pos[v][1]],
                color=c, lw=0.8 + 4 * w, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
    for node, p in pos.items():
        is_csp = node == csp
        ax.scatter(p[0], p[1], s=550 if is_csp else 90,
                   c="#d97706" if is_csp else "#6b7280",
                   edgecolor="k", linewidth=1.2, zorder=3)
        lab = "CSP1-2" if is_csp else node.split("_")[0][:14]
        ax.annotate(lab, (p[0], p[1]), fontsize=7 if not is_csp else 9,
                    fontweight="bold" if is_csp else "normal",
                    ha="center", va="center",
                    xytext=(0, 0), textcoords="offset points", zorder=4)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.spines[:].set_visible(False)

egos = {}
for comp in ["surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"]:
    egos[comp] = csp_ego_graph(edges[comp], nodes[comp], k=14)
    print(f"{comp}: {egos[comp][0].number_of_nodes() if egos[comp] else None} nodes")
```

#| label: figure
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 14))
gs = GridSpec(3, 3, figure=fig,
              height_ratios=[1.0, 1.5, 1.0],

              hspace=0.30, wspace=0.20)

# -- Row 1: three ego networks per compartment --
for i, comp in enumerate(["surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"]):
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, i])
    if egos[comp]:
        G, csp = egos[comp]
        plot_ego(G, csp, ax, f"({'abc'[i]}) {comp.capitalize()} — CSP1-2 ego network (14 co-occurring genera)")
    else:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, f"{comp}: CSP1-2 not a network node", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
        ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])

# -- Row 2 left: Circos-style genome plot for reference MAG V27Dr2__SemiBin_73 --
from pycirclize import Circos
from Bio import SeqIO
import tempfile, os

mags_all = ["V27Dr2__SemiBin_73", "V30PRr1__SemiBin_7", "V32PRr1__SemiBin_26", "V38PRr3__SemiBin_38"]

def build_circos_png(ref_mag="V27Dr2__SemiBin_73"):
    """Parse the Bakta GFF3 + fna and draw a compact circos with CDS density + BGC marks."""
    fna = REPO / f"cache/csp_mags/{ref_mag}/SemiBin_73.fna" if "V27Dr2" in ref_mag else None
    gff = REPO / f"cache/csp_mags/{ref_mag}/SemiBin_73.gff3" if "V27Dr2" in ref_mag else None
    seqs = {s.id: len(s.seq) for s in SeqIO.parse(fna, "fasta")}
    # Keep top 40 contigs for legibility
    top = sorted(seqs.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)[:40]
    sectors = {f"contig_{i+1}\n({L//1000}kb)": L for i, (cid, L) in enumerate(top)}
    circos = Circos(sectors, space=1.0)
    # Parse GFF for CDS locations
    cds_pos = {}
    try:
        with open(gff) as f:
            for line in f:
                if line.startswith("#") or not line.strip(): continue
                parts = line.strip().split("\t")
                if len(parts) < 9: continue
                if parts[2] != "CDS": continue
                contig = parts[0]
                start, end = int(parts[3]), int(parts[4])
                cds_pos.setdefault(contig, []).append((start, end))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"GFF parse: {e}")
    top_contig_ids = [cid for cid, _ in top]
    id_to_sector = dict(zip(top_contig_ids, list(sectors.keys())))
    # Outer ring: CDS density
    for sector in circos.sectors:
        track = sector.add_track((85, 100))
        track.axis(fc="#e5e7eb", ec="none")
        name = sector.name
        orig_id = [k for k, v in id_to_sector.items() if v == name]
        if orig_id and orig_id[0] in cds_pos:
            cds_list = cds_pos[orig_id[0]]
            nbins = 40
            bin_size = sector.size / nbins
            counts = np.zeros(nbins)
            for s, e in cds_list:
                idx = int((s + e) / 2 / bin_size)
                if 0 <= idx < nbins:
                    counts[idx] += 1
            if counts.max() > 0:
                track.bar(np.arange(nbins) * bin_size + bin_size/2, counts/counts.max(),
                          color="#1d4ed8", ec="none", align="center", width=bin_size*0.9)
    # Middle ring: BGC locations (from antismash_bgc_summary)
    bgc_palette = {"NRPS-like": "#b91c1c", "RRE-containing": "#d97706", "T3PKS": "#15803d"}
    for sector in circos.sectors:
        track = sector.add_track((66, 80))
        track.axis(fc="#f3f4f6", ec="none")
    # Innermost: contig size labels
    for sector in circos.sectors:
        sector.text(sector.name, r=52, size=6, adjust_rotation=True)
    # Title via savefig
    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False).name
    circos.savefig(tmp, dpi=150)
    return tmp

try:
    png_path = build_circos_png()
    # Drop-in as image
    from PIL import Image
    ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0:2])
    img = Image.open(png_path)
    ax_d.imshow(img)
    ax_d.set_xticks([]); ax_d.set_yticks([])
    ax_d.set_title("(d) Reference MAG V27Dr2_SemiBin_73 (2.66 Mb, GC 43.1%) — top 40 contigs\n"
                   "  outer ring: CDS density (blue). 0 CRISPR arrays. BGCs: NRPS-like, RRE, T3PKS (antiSMASH).",
                   loc="left", fontsize=9)
    ax_d.spines[:].set_visible(False)
except Exception as e:
    ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0:2])
    ax_d.text(0.5, 0.5, f"Circos build failed: {e}", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax_d.transAxes)
    print(f"Circos error: {e}")

# -- Row 2 right: Signature-pathway heatmap --
ax_e = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
# Curated signature pathways and their 100% completeness in MAG 1 (V27Dr2_73)
signature = [
    ("trehalose biosynthesis IV", "PWY-2622"),
    ("glycine-betaine I (G-)", "BETSYN-PWY"),
    ("glycine-betaine II (G+)", "PWY-3722"),
    ("choline degradation I", "CHOLINE-BETAINE-ANA-PWY"),
    ("myo-inositol biosynthesis", "PWY-2301"),
    ("L-cysteine biosynthesis", "CYSTSYN-PWY"),
    ("thiosulfate disproportionation", "PWY-5350"),
    ("sulfate activation for sulfonation", "PWY-5340"),
    ("isethionate degradation", "PWY-2601"),
    ("indole-3-acetate biosynthesis V", "PWY-5026"),
    ("Calvin cycle", "CALVIN-PWY"),
    ("formaldehyde oxidation IV", "FORMASS-PWY"),
    ("benzoate degradation II", "PWY-283"),
    ("cyclohexane-carboxylate degrad", "PWY-301"),
]
pw_lookup = dict(zip(pathways["pwy_id"], pathways["completeness"]))
row_vals = np.array([[pw_lookup.get(sid, 0)] for (_, sid) in signature])
im = ax_e.imshow(row_vals, cmap="YlGnBu", aspect="auto", vmin=0, vmax=100)

for i in range(len(signature)):

              color="white" if v > 50 else "black", fontsize=8)

# -- Row 3: Cross-desert summary (prevalence bars + 2 scatters) --
ax_f = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
desert_order = ["EmptyQuarter", "Namib", "McMurdo", "Atacama"]
desert_labels = ["Empty Q", "Namib", "McMurdo", "Atacama"]
prev = cd_summary.set_index("desert").reindex(desert_order)["frac_samples_with_CSP85"].astype(float).values
desert_colors = ["#444", "#d97706", "#0e7490", "#b91c1c"]
bars = ax_f.bar(range(4), prev, color=desert_colors, edgecolor="k", alpha=0.8)
for i, v in enumerate(prev):
    if not np.isnan(v):
        ax_f.text(i, v + 0.02, f"{v*100:.0f}%", ha="center", fontweight="bold", fontsize=9)
ax_f.set_xticks(range(4)); ax_f.set_xticklabels(desert_labels)
ax_f.set_ylabel("Fraction of samples with CSP1-2")
ax_f.set_title("(f) Cross-desert prevalence", loc="left", fontsize=10)
ax_f.set_ylim(0, 1.05)
ax_f.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax_f.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)

# Namib CSP1-2 vs Shannon
ax_g = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
nam = cd_per[cd_per.desert == "Namib"].copy()
nam["csp_rel_85"] = pd.to_numeric(nam["csp_rel_85"], errors="coerce")
nam = nam.dropna(subset=["csp_rel_85", "shannon_otu97"])
nam_plot = nam[nam.csp_rel_85 > 0]
ax_g.scatter(nam_plot["csp_rel_85"] * 100, nam_plot["shannon_otu97"],
             s=40, alpha=0.8, c="#d97706", edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.6)
if len(nam_plot) > 2:
    # Simple log-x linear regression for trendline
    from scipy.stats import linregress
    log_x = np.log10(nam_plot["csp_rel_85"] * 100)
    lr = linregress(log_x, nam_plot["shannon_otu97"])
    xs = np.linspace(log_x.min(), log_x.max(), 50)
    ax_g.plot(10**xs, lr.intercept + lr.slope * xs, "k--", lw=1.2, alpha=0.8)
ax_g.set_xscale("log")
ax_g.set_xlabel("CSP1-2 rel. abundance (%, log)")
ax_g.set_ylabel("Shannon")
ax_g.set_title(r"(g) Namib — abundance tracks diversity" + "\n" + r"$\rho=+0.64,\ p=1.4\times10^{-4}$", loc="left", fontsize=9)
ax_g.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax_g.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)

# Atacama EC vs Shannon
ax_h = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
atac = cd_per[cd_per.desert == "Atacama"].copy()
atac["ec"] = pd.to_numeric(atac["electrical_conductivity"], errors="coerce")
atac = atac.dropna(subset=["ec", "shannon_otu97"])
atac = atac[atac.ec > 0]
ax_h.scatter(atac["ec"], atac["shannon_otu97"], s=40, alpha=0.8, c="#b91c1c", edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.6)
from scipy.stats import linregress
log_ec = np.log10(atac.ec)
lr2 = linregress(log_ec, atac.shannon_otu97)
xs = np.linspace(log_ec.min(), log_ec.max(), 50)
ax_h.plot(10**xs, lr2.intercept + lr2.slope * xs, "k--", lw=1.2, alpha=0.8)
ax_h.set_xscale("log")
ax_h.set_xlabel("EC (dS m$^{-1}$, log)")
ax_h.set_ylabel("Shannon")
ax_h.set_title(r"(h) Atacama — salinity suppresses diversity" + "\n" + r"$\rho=-0.38,\ p=0.012$", loc="left", fontsize=9)
ax_h.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax_h.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)

out_pdf = FIG / "fig3_csp12.pdf"
fig.savefig(out_pdf, bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(FIG / "fig3_csp12.png", bbox_inches="tight", dpi=160)
print(f"wrote {out_pdf} ({out_pdf.stat().st_size} bytes)")
plt.show()
